parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is typically made of steel, forming the main structural component that holds the internal mechanism and connects the lid and base.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the spring and staple track, ensuring smooth staple movement and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but supports the lid’s pivoting motion during stapling.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is made of durable plastic and covers the top portion of the stapler.
parts.Functional_description: It is the part pressed by the user to drive a staple through paper and into the base anvil.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots downward around a hinge point to compress the internal spring and push the staple out.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of plastic and forms the bottom support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for stapling and contains the metal anvil that bends the staple legs inward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the foundation for the stapler’s movement.
